summary: The Healthy Hair Act amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to deem any hair straightening or smoothing product containing formaldehyde or formaldehyde-releasing substances as adulterated, effective 180 days after enactment, and requires the FDA to study health impacts on salon workers and report recommendations to Congress within two years.
